data.name: DragWheelHint
data.value: While dragging a file, press Shift to open the drag wheel.

data.value: To use the drag wheel, turn on the setting below, then press Shift while dragging a file.

data.name: DragWheelHelp
data.value: While this app is open, press Shift as you drag files from any window. Pause over the Tools slice to see the tools.

data.name: StartWithWindowsHelp
data.value: When you sign in, the app starts quietly in the system tray so the drag wheel is ready.

data.name: StartWithWindowsBlocked
data.value: Starting with Windows is turned off in Windows Settings, and only you can turn it back on there. Open Settings?

data.name: TrayHideOnClose
data.value: _Hide to tray on X without asking

data.name: CloseAppHelp
data.value: If you hide it, the drag wheel keeps working. To come back, use the icon next to the clock.

data.name: CloseAppBusy
data.value: Closing cancels the job that is running.

data.name: CensorHelp
data.value: Draw over what you want to hide; you can mark several areas. On the keyboard, the arrow keys move an area, Shift with them resizes it, and Space selects the next one. Your original stays as it is.

data.name: CensorMosaicWarning
data.value: Mosaic is made from the original, so shapes stay visible and text can sometimes be recovered. For sensitive information, choose Noise or Black.

data.name: SnapshotHelp
data.value: Saved as a full-size PNG. The original file does not change.

data.name: StatusMediaFeatureMissing
data.value: This needs the Windows Media Feature Pack. Add it under Settings > System > Optional features, then try again. No files were created.

data.name: EditHelp
data.value: Space plays. Arrows move a second, with Shift a frame. S splits, Delete removes, I and O cut the start and end, Ctrl+Z undoes. The original file does not change.

data.name: EditNoPlayback
data.value: Windows can't play this format. You still see frames, and saving works.

data.name: PdfMergeHelp
data.value: Alt with the arrow keys also moves a file. PDFs keep their own pages. The original files do not change.

data.name: StatusPdfNoText
data.value: {0} has no text to save, so it is probably a scan. Save its pages as pictures instead. No files were created.

data.name: OfficeDownloadQuestion
data.value:
Converting Word, Excel and PowerPoint files to PDF needs LibreOffice, a free office suite.
A 376 MB file will be downloaded from The Document Foundation, the makers of LibreOffice, and takes about 1.5 GB once unpacked. It goes in this app's own folder, only this app uses it, and it is removed when you uninstall the app. Your documents are not sent anywhere.
Download it now?

data.name: StatusOfficeDownloading
data.value: Downloading LibreOffice. This happens only once.

data.name: StatusOfficeDownloadFailed
data.value: LibreOffice could not be downloaded. Check your internet connection and disk space, then try again. No files were created.

data.name: CropHelp
data.value: Drag the corners. On the keyboard, the arrow keys move the area and Shift with them resizes it.

data.name: StatusBusy
data.value: Wait for the current job to finish, or cancel it first.
